name: Cowslaw
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by waiya
rules: COST – Choose a number for X that is greater than 0. Remove X tactics in your discard pile from the game. -- EFFECT – You may search your deck for a tactic with numeric cost X or less and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand. -- FLIP UP – 1 [O] and draw a card.
flavor: Also known as ruminant hash, or salmagundi stew.
notes: Card prints COST – where catalog has updated EXTRA COST: templating; otherwise identical. Seed 3 (SEED3 stamp) set symbol.

name: Devilfang Thunderhoof
subtitle: original Open R&D game mechanic by waiya
rules: UNIQUE THUNDERHOOF -- When this card enters play, put X tokens on it, where X is the number of [O] you control. -- This card gains 1 strength for each token on it. -- DISRUPT -- COST – Pay 2. Remove a token from this card. Pick an opponent. -- EFFECT – Your opponent discards a card.
notes: Card says 'Your opponent discards a card' (after picking an opponent); catalog says 'That player discards a card'. Same play.

name: Geiseric, the Souleater
subtitle: he's on a diet
rules: UNIQUE GEISERIC -- If a character is put into your opponent's hand from play,you may pay 1 instead. If you do, remove it from the game and put a token on this card. -- SOUL CONSUMPTION -- COST – Pay 2. Remove a token from this card. -- EFFECT – Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put 1 into your hand and 1 on the bottom of your deck.
notes: Card: 'If a character is put into your opponent's hand from play, you may pay 1 instead.' Catalog: 'would be put into an opponent's hand ... pay 1. If you do, ... instead' (updated templating, same effect). Card has typo 'play,you' (missing space).

name: God's Autograph
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by waiya
rules: All non-resource cards gain the rules text "Unique X", where X is the card's name.
flavor: "Can you carve your name into a stone twenty feet high? No? Then I guess you're not God."

name: Obsession
notes: Resource card, art rotated sideways with 'OBSESSION' printed vertically on the left edge; no type bar, text box or footer printed.

name: Pony Slaystation
subtitle: whoa... great graphics!
rules: When a character with 3 strength of less enters play under an opponent's control, destoy that character and inflict X damage to this card, where X is that character's strength.
flavor: I love rainbows and fountains... of blood.
notes: Card has typos 'strength of less' (for 'or less') and 'destoy' (for 'destroy'); catalog is corrected. Plays the same.

name: Spatchcocking
subtitle: life itself is the proper binge
rules: Each player chooses a card of each non-resource type they control. Put all remaining non-resource cards into their owner's hand. -- RECUR – [O][O][O][O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 4. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Each opponent reveals their hand, chooses a card of each non-resource type in it, and discards the remaining non-resource cards.

name: The Stone of Shame
subtitle: as a final humiliation, you must walk home naked
rules: If a character is put into a player's hand, destroy it instead.
notes: Catalog: 'If a character would be put into a player's hand, destroy it instead.' Card omits 'would'; same effect.

name: Anatidaephobia
rules: COST – Play this only in response to a character being played. If you did not play this card using FLIP UP, pay X, where X is the character's numeric cost. -- EFFECT – Terminate the character. -- FLIP UP – 1 [G] and your faction loses 5 influence.
flavor: "It's the quacking of that hideous heart!"
notes: Card says 'play' where catalog says 'deploy' (updated terminology), and prints COST where catalog has EXTRA COST. Subtitle line under the name is printed in an unreadable alien glyph script, so subtitle left null.

name: Fecal Urgency
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by waiya
rules: COST – Choose a number for X that is less than or equal to the number of [G] you control. -- EFFECT – Draw X cards. Your faction loses X+X influence.
flavor: When you gotta go, you gotta go.
notes: Card prints COST – where catalog has updated EXTRA COST: templating; otherwise identical.

name: Greed
notes: Resource card, art rotated sideways with 'GREED' printed vertically on the left edge; no type bar, text box or footer printed.

name: Intriguing Mezzanine
subtitle: you're invited to our fundraiser... we insist...
rules: COST – Pick 2 characters. -- When this card enter play, deplete those characters. -- PARTY ON! -- COST – Inflict 1 damage to this location. If you do, pick a character. -- EFFECT – Deplete the character. -- Characters depleted by this card cannot be restored by their controller's factions's RESTORE RULE.
notes: Card prints COST where catalog has EXTRA COST; card typo 'enter play' (catalog 'enters play'). 'factions's' is printed on the card as well.

name: Port Manteau
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by Lekkit
rules: When this card enters play, name a card subtype. -- Players must pay 2 to play cards with the named subtype.
flavor: "We don't take kindly to strangers 'round here!"
notes: Card says 'to play cards', catalog says 'to deploy cards' (updated terminology).

name: Prestige Inversion
subtitle: you never waste time. time wastes you.
rules: COST – Pick a character with the UNIQUE keyword in its rules text. -- EFFECT – Remove the character from the game. -- RECUR – [G][G] -- COST – Use this only while this card is in your discard pile. Pay 1. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
notes: Card prints COST – where catalog has updated EXTRA COST: templating; otherwise identical.

name: Vilghame Manewaft
subtitle: He knows you ate his pudding.
typeLine: BANKER CHARACTER – vilghame, sword of great justice
rules: UNIQUE VILGHAME -- Your opponent must pay 1 to play a tactic. -- The first resource each opponent plays each turn enters play attached to that opponent's faction.
flavor: How can you have any pudding if you don't eat your meat?!
notes: Card: 'Your opponent must pay 1 to play a tactic' / 'that opponent's faction'; catalog: 'Your opponents ... deploy a tactic' / 'that player's faction'. Updated terminology and plural, same play.

name: 94r913 My 908570pp3r5
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by Paul

notes: Card says 'played this card using FLIP UP' where catalog says 'deployed' (updated terminology), and prints COST where catalog has EXTRA COST.

name: Elitism

name: Ensmallment Ray

name: Hilarious Refrigerator Alarm
subtitle: uh uh uh! You didn't say the magic word

Otherwise, each opponent may put 3 Micromajig tokens into play under their control. -- FLIP UP – 2 [E][E] and you may play a resource.
notes: Card says 'All unresolved cards are terminated.' Catalog says 'All other unresolved cards are terminated.' ('other' is not on the card; could change whether this card terminates itself). Also 'played' vs catalog 'deployed' (terminology only).

name: Merbegon, the Insatiable Taxidermist
rules: UNIQUE MERBEGON -- This card can attack even if it has not been in play under your control since the start of the turn. -- If a character enters play under your control, you may destroy that character. If you do, X is that character's strength and Y is that character's life. You may pick a character. If you do, it gains X strength and Y life this turn.
notes: Card says 'If a character enters play under your control'; catalog says 'When a character enters play ...'. Same trigger. Name wraps onto two lines so there is no subtitle.

name: Notion Sickness
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by GooDMaN88
rules: COST – Pick a card you control with an ability in its rules text. -- EFFECT – You may use one of the card's abilities. If you do, the effect happens twice instead of once. Destroy the card.
flavor: Sometimes the mother of invention is madness.
notes: Card prints COST – where catalog has updated EXTRA COST: templating; otherwise identical.

name: Axeclaw Grandchest
subtitle: original Open R&D game mechanic by waiya
rules: UNIQUE GRANDCHEST -- The top card of your deck is revealed at all times. -- While the top card of your deck is revealed, this card gains X strength, where X is the numeric cost of that card. -- SHAKE UP -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Shuffle your deck.

name: Community Chest
subtitle: original Open R&D game mechanic by waiya
rules: UNIQUE COMMUNITY CHEST -- At the start of each player's turn, both players may draw a card or play a resource. -- If you control at least [D] and choose to put this card on the bottom of your deck as part of your mulligan at the start of a game, you may reveal it. If you do, draw a card at the start of your turn.
notes: Card says 'both players may draw a card or play a resource'; catalog says 'each player may ...'. Same play.

name: Deception
notes: Resource card, art rotated sideways with 'DECEPTION' printed vertically on the left edge; no type bar, text box or footer printed.

name: Delicious Strawberry Flavored Death
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by MrJennings
rules: Deplete all non-Rogue characters. Draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 1 [D] and your faction loses 5 influence.
flavor: "I don't understand it. James Coco went mad in fifteen minutes!"

name: Fornicaves

(But don't detach your resources.) -- DEVELOP RULE -- At the start of your turn, reduce the numeric cost of the next character you play this turn by 2. -- DRAW -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- RESOURCE -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Play a resource. -- INTERNAL CONFLICT -- At the end of your turn, flip a coin. Pick a character another Hero controls. -- EFFECT – The Villain takes control of the character. Claim one card in the Temptation Pile. -- SPRING FORTH MY BURLY PROTECTOR! -- COST – Pay 6. -- EFFECT – Reveal the top card of the Hero deck and claim it. -- TEAMWORK -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a card you control. Choose another player. -- EFFECT – The player takes control of the card. -- YOUR TRUE COLORS ARE REVEALED -- At the start of the Villain's turn, put a token on this card. If there are 7 tokens on this card, all Heroes turn their Allegiance cards face-up. -- (See the included Showdown rules card for more details.)

name: The Evil Alliance
rules: X is the number of opponents you have at the start of the game. (You start with 15 + 10 times X influence.) -- STARTING RESOURCES -- Any 1+X staple resources -- STARTING DRAW -- 7 going first, 8 going second -- RESTORE RULE -- At the start of your turn, restore all your depleted cards and detach all resources from your faction. -- DEVELOP RULE -- At the start of your turn, draw a card or play a resource. Play a resource. Put the top card of the Hero deck into the Temptation Pile. -- DARING GAMBIT -- If a Hero inflicts at least 7 damage to another Hero this turn, the damaging Hero claims the entire Temptation Pile. -- OMNIPOTENCE -- You automatically meet all thresholds, even if you don't control the proper resource icons. -- (See the included Showdown rules card for more details.)

(But please, play with it for fun!) -- STARTING RESOURCES -- 2 Greed -- STARTING DRAW -- 3 going first, 4 going second -- HIDDEN INFLUENCE -- Your opponent ignores their faction's STARTING DRAW rule and uses this card's rule instead. -- DEVELOP RULE – PULLING STRINGS -- Your opponent ignores their faction's DEVELOP RULE. -- RESTORE RULE -- At the start of your turn, restore all your depleted cards and detach all resources from your faction. -- INFLATIONARY FORCES – DRAW -- COST – Both players may use this ability. name: The Union of Unextraordinary Miners

You start with X staple resources and 1 Deception.
